events.text: Change tracking starts here: 19 models and 4,747 citations on record. From the next refresh this entry lists what moved.
GeneCompass's repository is being actively developed again.
“Benchmarking biomedical foundation models” (Nature Methods) — covers Nicheformer.
“Basal expression predicts context-specific drug responses only where they are reproducible: a leakage-safe 47-line LOCO benchmark on Tahoe-100M” (Research Square) — covers STATE.
20 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.
Geneformer's repository is being actively developed again.
“A systematic comparison of single-cell perturbation response prediction models” (Science Advances) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, scFoundation, STATE.

“Cell-type separability predicts annotation accuracy and outweighs algorithm choice: a factorial benchmark across seven scRNA paradigms” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, scBERT, scFoundation.
“scDiagnostics: systematic assessment of cell type annotation in single-cell transcriptomics data” (Briefings in Bioinformatics) — covers scGPT.
26 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.
“Benchmarking methods for inferring single-cell transcription factor activity using large-scale perturbation sequencing data” (Briefings in Bioinformatics) — covers scGPT, scFoundation.
“An open benchmark and language models for AI in aging biology” (Cell) — covers scGPT.
23 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.
“Evaluating Large‐Language Models in Bioinformatics Applications” (Advanced Computing) — covers scGPT.
